title: Small accounting firm with cloud email and an AI assistant

organisation.name: Brightwater & Lowe
organisation.size: 35 staff; IT run by a partner and an outside contractor
organisation.summary: Brightwater & Lowe prepares tax returns and payroll for about 900 small businesses and families. Staff work on laptops in the office or from home over the office VPN, keep client tax files and ID scans on a NAS file server, and use a cloud email and documents suite with single sign-on and push MFA. A practice management service holds client records and billing. Last year a partner connected an AI email assistant that reads every mailbox to draft replies and summarise attachments, and the NAS is backed up nightly to a cloud backup service.

reviewNotes: Beginner: flat office network, password-only VPN, push MFA that can be spammed, a shared admin password and an AI assistant with a tenant-wide mail grant.
